# A-to-Mind

> Void by A-to-Mind is a blank stage with one quiet input. Ask for something and it appears. Nothing is shown until someone asks, and there is nothing to sign up for.

## What you can ask for today
- Things on the stage: a clock, timer, counter, sticky note, notepad, list, calculator, shape, image or link card ("make a 5 minute timer", "draw a circle", "add a sticky that says hi"). They stay in your browser across visits.
- Changes to the stage: "make it blue", "make everything bigger", "clear", "undo".
- Books, TV, teams and holidays: "books by Octavia Butler", "tv show Severance", "nba team Celtics", "public holidays in Japan".
- Floating pages: the weather ("weather in Tokyo"), UV index ("UV index in Miami", "should I wear sunscreen in Phoenix"), recent earthquakes ("earthquakes near Tokyo", "recent earthquakes"), pollen and allergy levels ("pollen in Paris", "allergy forecast in Berlin"), the time anywhere ("time in Tokyo", "3pm London to Tokyo", "sunset in Paris"), a street map ("map of Lisbon", "where is Kyoto"), a translation ("translate hello to Spanish"), a calculation or conversion ("5 miles in km", "100 usd in eur"), a loan payment ("monthly payment on a $250000 mortgage at 6.5% for 30 years"), trip fuel ("gas cost for 320 miles at 28 mpg $3.59 a gallon"), a tip or bill split ("20% tip on 45", "split $85 three ways with 20% tip"), or a page about almost anything ("what is a black hole"), with its source linked.
- Keep a page as a card with "keep this"; "call this ...", "take this off" and "same again" work on it.
- Your own look: "make my void deep blue", "add stars", "quieter font", "reset my void".
- Optional, never required: "remember me" keeps your stage, look and kept cards on every device with a passkey (no password, no email). Then "sign in" on another device, "am I signed in", "sign out", "forget me". Agents can't ask these for someone.
- "menu" or "what can I do" lists every skill, clickable.

## Linking to an answer
- https://a-to-mind.com/?q=<ask> opens Void and runs the ask, for example https://a-to-mind.com/?q=weather%20in%20Tokyo

## Notes for crawlers and agents
- Everything runs in the browser at https://a-to-mind.com. There is no public API, CLI or SDK.
- Browser agents with WebMCP (Chrome) find Void's tools declared on the page itself (void_ask, void_stage, void_calculate, ...): each takes one plain-words ask and returns what appeared. The same list is at https://a-to-mind.com/tools.json.
- Earlier pages on this domain described a different product (workflow execution, treaties, ledgers). They are retired.
Ask "summon a sprite" for a roaming 3D friend in your own Void; "send them away" clears it.
